alert.fallback: Dose controller fell back to the fixed dosing schedule: {reason}. Ratio control resumes when the irrigation monitor data returns.
alert.fallback_ended: Dose controller: fixed-schedule fallback ended after {secs} s ({why}). Cause was: {cause}.
alert.overdose: Dose controller closed {tank}: {tank}: {dosed} L dosed vs {target} L target (> {factor}x) for {water} L of water. Check the valve and the venturi.
alert.valve_leak: Dose controller: {tank} drew {litres} L while commanded closed (ch {channel}) — the valve may be stuck open; re-sent OFF.
alert.ph_floor: Fertigation pH {ph} fell below the {floor} floor — pH Down valve closed and locked out for the rest of this cycle ({acid_s} s acid used). Check the acid dosing and the probe.
alert.ph_not_verifiable: Dose controller: feed pH not verifiable ({detail}) — pH Down valve held closed.
alert.ph_sensor_fault: Dose controller: feed pH sensor {kind} ({detail}) — pH Down valve closed for the rest of this cycle.
alert.acid_cap_cycle: Dose controller: acid cap reached ({cap} s per cycle) with feed pH {ph} still above {setpoint} — no more pH Down this cycle.
alert.acid_cap_day: Dose controller: acid cap reached ({cap} s per day) with feed pH {ph} still above {setpoint} — no more pH Down this day.
alert.valve_mismatch: Dose controller: {valve} (ch {channel}) reads ON while commanded OFF — OFF re-sent.
alert.underdose: Dose controller: {tank} could not reach 1:{ratio} — valve open {open_pct} % of the run, achieved 1:{achieved} ({dosed} L for {water} L water). Venturi draw is below what the ratio needs.

reason.disarmed_hold: automations disarmed — dosing valves held closed
reason.stale_since_delay: no pH sample since the start delay ended {secs} s ago
reason.frozen: pH stuck at {ph} for {secs} s while water flows
reason.flow_watch_retry: flow watch cold-restart retry: {zone} no water
reason.window_short: pH window {window} s is shorter than the plant lag (tau {tau} s + dead time {dead} s)

gate.no_ph_tank: no pH Down tank bound to the dosing board
gate.locked_out: pH fell below {floor} — locked out this cycle
gate.cap_cycle: acid cap reached ({cap} s this cycle)
